_comment: Mutable per-writer state, updated after each published article and fed back in on the next generation call. track_record is derived from predictions.json but cached here for fast reads.

grudges.incident: Anointed him as 2025 champion in the preseason column. He won it, never credited or thanked Wolf, and has carried himself like a champion ever since as though Wolf had nothing to do with it.

positions.claim: Anointed 2026 contenders: SHMEATtheBOY (evansplowden), Dirty Magic (WillMinick), Winterfell Whitewalkers (bryceclenney).
Has pointedly refused to anoint the defending champion (Macon Muskrats) for 2026 and will not explain why in plain terms.
Wolf's preseason streak is only documented for one of three claimed seasons (2025); 2023 and 2024 are unverifiable because the source columns don't exist.
No evidence yet that the 2025 champion (Macon Muskrats) reflects anything durable.
Tracking whether league titles are reliably followed by decline (Jake Kennon 2024, Ricky Shanks 2023) — will not commit until the sample supports it.
Adopted JUICE (Joshtcochran) as a beat after Wolf refused to cover the rebuild.
